text:
Asha: Quick handoff: final provisioning checklist for GA. Pushed the living playbook to Drive, want to call out remaining risks before we lock.
Ben: call out top 3 blockers pls.
Asha: Top 3: 1) SLA wording & measurable formulas, 2) failover + fallback model variants + config snippets, 3) live oncall coverage for first 72h + clear escalation.
Carlos: infra heads-up 50%: we have a maintenance window Wed (1772580000) that could interfere with burn-in; avoid cutover that day.
Dana: For SLA buckets, do we want p95-focused SLOs or include p99 for legal? Need recommended numbers.
Asha: Proposed SLOs for GA (non-penalized): Hosted gen (<512 tokens) p95 <= 250ms, p99 <= 700ms. Dedicated baseline p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 400ms.
Emily: We must specify measurement method (synthetic probes vs client-side telemetry). Add exact probe intervals and aggregation window in playbook.
Ben: Also define automated rollback/fallback rules: what triggers fallback, which model variant, and who can flip the switch.
Carlos: Infra recommends auto-route to quantized-warm variant + drain to warm pool before full rollback. I'll add the envoy/routing snippet.
Frank: Oncall plan: two-person primary (platform + product PM) for 72h, then revert to normal SRE rotation. I6ll draft rota.
Tara: Docs: will add an "Errors & retries" section with Python/Node examples and a short circuit-breaker snippet.
Emily: Monitoring panels: request_rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, error_rate, kv_cache_hit_ratio, burst_queue_len, per-model cost_per_token.
Ben: Add a short table for log retention/enterprise audit retention.
Asha: Retention table in playbook: logs=90d, audit_trail=365d (enterprise opt-in), raw_metrics=30d, aggregated_metrics=1y.
Carlos: If infra cannot grant a 48h blackout, we should not schedule the prod cutover that week.
Frank: Escalation draft (short): sev1 -> oncall -> eng-sre -> eng-runtime -> CTO; sev2 -> oncall -> eng-runtime -> product -> CSM. I'll put as a code block.
Asha: Need canary acceptance script: smoke checks, SLA probes pre/post rollout, synthetic checks across regions.
Ben: Canary smoke: 100 synthetic requests per region, assert >=95% of requests meet p95 target and error_rate <0.5%.
Dana: Legal: keep SLA language as "SLO-backed commitments" for GA; no automatic refunds until penalty policy finalized.
Asha: Mark SLA copy as non-penalized SLOs for GA; finalize penalty tiers in GA+1.
Lucy: Pricing: need an SLA-tier -> discount/credit placeholder in the playbook. I'll draft a mapping and sync with Phil.
Phil: I have a customer-facing summary draft; will coordinate wording with Docs + Legal before publishing.
Emily: Runbook diagnostics: steps to check if issue is model perf or kv-cache: cache_hit_ratio, last_cache_evict_ts, token_loop_signatures in logs.
Frank: I'll format runbook snippets and link dashboard play buttons to each diagnostic step.
Tara: Docs owners1 confirmed. I'll add SDK call patterns, retry/backoff examples, and a short troubleshooting FAQ.
Ben: Also include ownership matrix: who owns SLA enforcement, billing disputes, incident follow-up.
Asha: Ownership list (GA handoff): SLA finalization: Dana + Emily; Failover config: Carlos + Frank; SDK/docs: Emily + Tara; Oncall rota: Frank + ops-oncall; Pricing mapping: Lucy + Phil.
Emily: Add alert thresholds mapping to paging policy: warn -> slack channel, page -> oncall. Include noise reduction rules to avoid pager storms.
Frank: Will add suppression windows for known benign spikes and include manual override steps.
Carlos: I'll request the 48h blackout; if denied we gate the launch week.
Phil: Can we do a quick 30m review Thurs 10:30 PT once drafts are in? I'll invite legal/ops/docs/infra/product.
Asha: Scheduled Thurs 10:30 PT. Please add inline comments in Drive beforehand.
oncall-bot: Reminder  scheduled maintenance: infra-upgrade on 1772580000  see #eng-infra for details. :bell:
Asha: Final timeline in playbook: SLA & failover config EOD +2; oncall rota & runbook EOD +3; docs checklist EOD +4; pricing placeholder EOD +5.
Ben: Dependencies to call out: infra blackout (Carlos), legal phrasing (Dana), finops pricing mapping (Lucy).
Lucy: I'll slot a placeholder pricing table and follow up with Phil.
Asha: Thanks everyone. I'll update the Drive playbook now and tag owners. :thumbsup:
